scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “An integral scalar curvature bound for real simplicial volume” (preprints/An-integral-scalar-curvature-bound-for-real-simplicial-volume-October-5-2026/v126-proof.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 335 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d5ed8374cef6389d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every integer n ≥ 3, there is a constant an > 0, depending only on n, such that every closed connected oriented smooth n-manifold M and every smooth Riemannian metric g on M satisfy Z M (Scal− g )n/2 dVg ≥ an∥M∥. (1.1)
